title: Chinese White Stir-Fry Sauce

ingredientGroups.title: Sauce
items: 3 cups chinese chicken stock (chinese: chicken/scallion/ginger, western: chicken/carrot/onion/celery)
¾ inch of ginger, peeled and grated

ingredientGroups.title: Sample Stir-Fry
items: 2-3 cups vegetables (mushrooms, broccoli, snow peas, cauliflower, carrot)
¾ cup Chinese White Stir-Fry sauce

steps: Combine all of the sauce ingredients and whisk or blend until thoroughly combined. Note that the chicken stock must be cool or the corn starch will prematurely thicken and clump.
Add 1-2 Tbsp neutral oil to a preheated wok and stir fry the chicken over high heat until no longer pink.
Add the garlic and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the vegetables, tossing frequently until desired doneness, approximately 1-3 minutes.
Reduce the heat and add the shaoxing wine and white stir fry sauce. Toss for an additional 10-30 seconds until the sauce thickens or reduces to the desired texture.
sourceNote: Note: Try this sauce as the base for a Moo Goo Gai Pan
